## Checks
- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run build` and `npm run check:content` pass
- [ ] I played it: units in the dev server, a new archetype in the lab (`/spanish-arcade/lab/?archetype=<id>`)
- [ ] Unit, exercise and word ids of existing content are unchanged (a reworked exercise gets a new id and `rev` goes up)
- [ ] A new unit has `"status": "review"` (not `approved`; only the owner approves)
